title: Quantum Numbers
description: Essential Criteria: Provide the correct quantum numbers for the ground and excited states of helium.

title: Pauli Principle Explanation
description: Important Criteria: Clearly explain the role of the Pauli exclusion principle in determining energy levels.

title: Perturbation Notation
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly express the perturbation formulas for the helium states without evaluating integrals.

title: Energy Corrections
description: Important Criteria: Include the correct expressions for energy corrections of both triplet and singlet states.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Avoid common sign mistakes in the expressions for energy corrections.
